description: This file defines structures, function types, and function prototypes for managing notes in a version control system, including operations like adding, removing, copying, and displaying notes, as well as handling notes references and configurations.

classes.name: notes_tree
classes.description: Structure encapsulating the internal notes tree, including references, combine function, and state flags.

methods.name: default_notes_ref
methods.description: Returns the default notes reference string based on configuration or environment.

methods.name: init_notes
methods.description: Initializes a notes_tree structure with a specified reference, combine function, and flags.

methods.name: add_note
methods.description: Adds a note object to the notes_tree, with optional combination logic.

methods.name: remove_note
methods.description: Removes a note object from the notes_tree.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves the note object for a given object ID.

methods.name: copy_note
methods.description: Copies a note from one object to another within the notes_tree.

methods.name: for_each_note
methods.description: Iterates over all notes in the notes_tree, invoking a callback.

methods.name: write_notes_tree
methods.description: Persists the current state of the notes_tree to the object database.

methods.name: prune_notes
methods.description: Removes notes associated with non-existing objects.

methods.name: free_notes
methods.description: De-initializes and frees resources of a notes_tree.
